facts.fact: 塔拉辛与卡希尔道别、走进那片树木歪斜的丛林，走了半小时，听见群山对她歌唱。
facts.anchor: Half an hour into her trek—half an hour after she bade farewell to Cahyir and vanished into the jungle of crooked trees

facts.fact: 越往坡上走，越来越多的野猪朝她冲来，有时成群结队。
facts.anchor: more and more of the boars charged at her, sometimes in groups

facts.fact: 她找不到更合适的说法，只能说这些野猪「不正常」。
facts.anchor: They weren’t—normal, for lack of a better word.

facts.fact: 她咬紧牙关抓住那对獠牙，用尽全身力气一扭，喉咙里挤出一声嘶哑的叫。
facts.anchor: Talasyn gritted her teeth and gripped those tusks and twisted, with a hoarse shout, with all her might.

facts.fact: 那女身的指甲套着与乌尔杜佳临朝时同款的金色锥形甲。
facts.anchor: her nails were tipped with the same kind of golden stiletto cones that Urduja Silim donned whenever she held court

facts.fact: 瓦利萨的航母在夜空里崩解，阿拉里克却没有半点胜利的感觉。
facts.anchor: Alaric felt no sense of triumph as the Valisante carrier disintegrated in the evening sky overhead.

facts.fact: 他当面说，因为她的缘故，他折损了过半舰队。
facts.anchor: I lost over half my fleet because of you.

facts.fact: 天幕再次移位，两人暂借的那条联结断成两半。
facts.anchor: And the heavens shifted again, and their temporary connection snapped in half.
